measurement_sources: These revisions identify the agent trials. Admission, assembly and shutdown measurements retain the sources identified in their child records; none are relabeled as final-release measurements.

agent_protocol.transport: Parent relays agent-chosen requests and outcomes; initialization is outside the MCP request budget.
agent_protocol.byte_scope: Compact UTF-8 decoded JSON result; excludes HTTP framing and JSON-RPC envelopes.

actual_agent_trials.observed_issue: Two automatic approval rejections delayed local client setup. The initialized session expired before tools/list; the request returned a transport failure. No geometry, publication or download was established.
actual_agent_trials.comparison_exclusion_reason: The original direct-client transport could not run. It was replaced with parent-mediated requests for all four completed trials; this failed attempt is retained separately.

actual_agent_trials.observed_issue: Full discovery succeeded. A 413-second parent scheduling pause exceeded the 300-second session idle lifetime; validation and the read-only status recovery attempt returned transport failures. No geometry, publication or download was established.
actual_agent_trials.comparison_exclusion_reason: Parent scheduling expired the session before task work. The failure remains recorded but is not attributed to candidate geometry or schema behavior.

actual_agent_trials.observed_issue: The parent assigned printable://contracts/v1/index instead of the implemented printable://contracts. resources/read returned -32601; a subsequent skill.list attempt was blocked locally because its contract had not been read. No geometry, publication or download was attempted.
actual_agent_trials.comparison_exclusion_reason: The operator supplied an unsupported URI. The observed error does not establish that resources/read or the canonical contract index was unavailable.

agent_attempt_accounting.source: Retained participant summaries, allowlisted request journals and independent classifications. Implementation labels refer to the baseline_revision and candidate_revision above.
agent_attempt_accounting.comparison_scope: Only the four task-success records use the common mediated transport and valid assigned discovery routes. Failures are retained without a population success-rate claim; replacement trials are fresh sessions, not replay of an uncertain mutation.

setup_failures_before_agent_requests.observed_issue: Initialization returned a transport failure before a usable session or agent request. Owned server cleanup was recorded.
setup_failures_before_agent_requests.comparison_exclusion_reason: No model participant trial started; the underlying initialization cause is unconfirmed.

setup_failures_before_agent_requests.observed_issue: The local launcher passed the Python executable as script input and exited with SyntaxError before starting the replacement trial.
setup_failures_before_agent_requests.comparison_exclusion_reason: Launcher invocation failure; no model participant or MCP task request started. The invocation was corrected before trial-a2.

common_agent_outcomes.scope: Completed trials only; failed attempts retain their individual outcomes above.

admission.refusal: HTTP 429 with error server_busy before dispatch; accepted disconnect/timeouts remain uncertain and must not be blindly retried.
admission.measurement_scope: Fresh real server subprocess VmHWM; clients/fake bridge outside measured process. One observation per offered level; deliberate SIGKILL teardown.

assembly.geometry_oracles: Both cubes have volume 1 mm³; separated clearance is 1 mm with zero interference; overlapping interference is 0.5 mm³. There are 48, 768, and 12,288 triangles per cube, two arrangements, and three trials each.

shutdown.candidate_foreground_restart: completed; immutable bytes preserved; engine starts once

limitations: Linux/arm64 local development binaries in Docker on a macOS host; software-only, not supported Linux/amd64 NVIDIA qualification.
One completed actual-agent trial per source and discovery mode. Wall time includes parent mediation and scheduling; no causal speedup or population completion claim.
Exact inherited model name, actual provider token usage and total model exposure bytes unavailable; decoded response bytes are not token estimates.
Full catalog increased from 209,836 to 219,138 bytes. Broader candidate additions prevent attributing the change solely to error contracts.
Memory is approximate kernel high-water accounting for the defined processes/fixtures, not allocation bounds or machine sizing. Admission disposal used SIGKILL.
Reserved controls cover retained-work saturation. Shared body readers and finite control/subscription slots can themselves saturate.
Assembly batches were sequential and used different input filesystems, without CPU pinning or controlled external load; slower native candidate times remain recorded.
Native mesh/assembly oracle matches do not establish physical manufacturing, GPU rendering performance, real printer stop, or complete operator-provisioned reconstruction.
Three failed agent attempts and two pre-trial setup failures are retained with individual exclusion reasons; completed-trial comparisons do not establish overall success rates.
Some cleanup checks initially failed and passed unchanged reruns; their causes remain unconfirmed.
Later source changes were not remeasured. Historical source identities, response sizes and timings do not qualify the final images.

final_source_gates.coverage: Rust formatting, warnings-denied clippy, locked workspace tests, addon and script unit tests, Python syntax, documentation, shell and publication permissions

public_release_verification.components: Official GitHub CLI verified provenance and SPDX SBOM bundles without credentials for every component. Verified statements match the retrieved inventories.
public_release_verification.record_provenance: Official GitHub CLI verification passed in the publication workflow before update discovery advanced.
public_release_verification.retained_materials: SBOMs, the declared supplement, repository notices, scan reports, policy and VEX inputs, tested IDs and component bundles were retrieved from the immutable record.

public_package_access.release_record: anonymous pull and inventory retrieval passed
